items.title: Phillips 66 (PSX) Stock May Be Below Fair Value On Cash Flow
items.summary: Phillips 66 has delivered a very strong run over the past few years, which naturally pushes investors to ask whether the current share price still lines up with the cash the business can generate. With the stock now trading at US$255.87, the key issue is how much of that past strength is genuinely supported by the company’s underlying cash flows.
